verdict.rationale: Isaac Sim documents programmatic control through ROS 2 services and actions that load worlds, spawn entities and step simulations. It also ships pip-installable Python namespace packages for composing the app, and Isaac Lab runs headless, so the product can be driven entirely through code. The missing OpenAPI spec reflects that this is an SDK rather than a REST service, and it is not counted as a failure. Missing for 10: a cited in-depth API reference (Python class/function docs), any remote or HTTP API surface, and independent hands-on corroboration of scripting the product end-to-end.
